rename.from: File view for an old commit offers a bogus RSS feed link
rename.to: File view for a specific commit offers a bogus RSS feed link

body:
Template for the RSS button

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/abe2755f7aaa77acddb8a7e3a85f68fd04f04101/templates/repo/view_file.tmpl#L66

uses `RefName`, which works for a `src/branch` path but not for `src/commit`. A feed of a commit makes no sense, so the link for a file feed in the commit page should be as in branch page.

I may try to fix it later.

issue.body:
On a file page of a specific commit, ensure the RSS button still links to the branch.

Fix #35855

body:
Remove the button from commit page,

```html
{{if and .EnableFeed .RefFullName.IsBranch}}
```

or leave a disabled link or try to link to default branch?
Maybe we should remove the link when viewing a commit, and only keep it when the user is viewing a branch or tag.
